_comment: Power Fx for the 'Onboarding Portal' canvas app (tablet layout). Data sources: the 'Onboarding Requests' SharePoint list and Office 365 Users, both standard connectors, so a Microsoft 365 licence is enough. Canvas apps show SharePoint columns by display name; tests/Contract.Tests.ps1 checks every column name and status used here against contract/onboarding-lists.json. The recorder builds the screens in Power Apps Studio from this file (demo.md step 5).

NewRequestScreen.btnSubmit.DisplayMode: If(IsBlank(txtGivenName.Text) || IsBlank(txtSurname.Text) || IsBlank(txtJobTitle.Text) || IsBlank(cmbManager.Selected) || IsBlank(ddDepartment.Selected) || dpStart.SelectedDate < Today(), DisplayMode.Disabled, DisplayMode.Edit)

MyRequestsScreen.galRequests.Items: Sort(Filter('Onboarding Requests', 'Created By'.Email = User().Email), Created, SortOrder.Descending)
MyRequestsScreen.lblStatus.Color: Switch(ThisItem.Status.Value, "Account created", Color.Green, "Failed", Color.Red, "Rejected", Color.Red, Color.DarkGray)
